verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A platform that ships reporting automation and AI agents, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The evidence never documents version history, change review, or rollback for the automations themselves. 'Versioned forecasts' covers planning data, approving mapping suggestions covers individual agent outputs, and audit logs are a general security control, so all three are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
